command:
. ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null; PORT=$(python3 - <<'PY'
from serial.tools import list_ports
serial='40:4C:CA:5D:01:D8'
m=[p for p in list_ports.comports() if p.serial_number==serial and p.vid==0x303A]
if len(m)!=1: raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one emulator C6, got {[p.device for p in m]}')
print(m[0].device)
PY
); echo EMU_PORT=$PORT; echo '=== STRAP DEFINITIONS ==='; grep -RniE 'GPIO_STRAP_REG|STRAP.*GPIO9|GPIO9.*STRAP|DOWNLOAD.*BOOT|BOOT.*DOWNLOAD' "$IDF_PATH/components/soc/esp32c6" "$IDF_PATH/components/bootloader_support" 2>/dev/null | head -160 || true; echo '=== RESOLVE GPIO_STRAP_REG ==='; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re, os
roots=[Path(os.environ['IDF_PATH'])/'components/soc/esp32c6/include/soc', Path(os.environ['IDF_PATH'])/'components/soc/esp32c6/register']
text='\n'.join(p.read_text(errors='ignore') for root in roots if root.exists() for p in root.rglob('*.h'))
def macro(name):
    m=re.search(r'^#define\s+'+re.escape(name)+r'\s+(.+)$', text, re.M)
    return m.group(1).strip() if m else None
print('GPIO_STRAP_REG_EXPR='+str(macro('GPIO_STRAP_REG')))
print('DR_REG_GPIO_BASE_EXPR='+str(macro('DR_REG_GPIO_BASE')))
expr=macro('GPIO_STRAP_REG'); base=macro('DR_REG_GPIO_BASE')
addr=None
if expr and base:
    bm=re.search(r'0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+', base)
    om=re.search(r'\+\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)', expr)
    if bm and om: addr=int(bm.group(0),16)+int(om.group(1),16)
if addr is None: raise SystemExit('could not resolve GPIO_STRAP_REG')
print(f'GPIO_STRAP_REG_ADDR=0x{addr:08x}')
Path('/tmp/c6_gpio_strap_addr').write_text(hex(addr))
PY
; ADDR=$(cat /tmp/c6_gpio_strap_addr); echo '=== RAW STRAP REGISTER ==='; set +e; python -m esptool --chip esp32c6 -p "$PORT" --before no_reset --after no_reset --no-stub read_mem "$ADDR" 2>&1; RC=$?; set -e; echo STRAP_READ_RC=$RC
